English / Simplified Chinese LSTM trained data (4.0.0_best_int)
https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
Distributed by @tesseract.js-data/eng@1.0.0 and @tesseract.js-data/chi_sim@1.0.0
Tesseract trained data is distributed under Apache-2.0.

All scripts, WASM and language files are served from the site's own origin.
No user document is sent to an OCR service. Models are fetched on first use.
